name: crow-acp
description: Crow assistant-ui chat connected directly to a local ACP WebSocket agent.

crowAcp.accessibilityVerbosity.description: Announce how to open chat accessibility help when the chat gains focus.

crowAcp.endpoint.description: Local ACP WebSocket endpoint, reached directly by the chat webview.

crowAcp.cwd.description: Agent working directory. Empty uses the active workspace folder (a Linux path when the extension runs in WSL).

crowAcp.protocol.description: ACP protocol version. Auto uses the existing Crow client endpoint detection.

crowAcp.mcpConfig.default:
mcpServers:
  crow-mcp:
    transport: stdio
    command: crow-cli
    args: [mcp2]
crowAcp.mcpConfig.description: MCP server configuration (YAML or JSON) supplied to the agent. Stdio commands run on the agent machine.

scripts.build: bun build src/extension.ts --target=node --format=cjs --external=vscode --outfile=dist/extension.cjs && bun ../chat/node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --config vite.config.ts
scripts.package: bun run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --out crow-acp-0.1.0.vsix
